IB 2027 · SL · Unit 8

Unit 8: The IA Cycle

Key Terms and Definitions

TermDefinition
success criteriaMeasurable conditions used to judge whether a solution meets requirements.
stakeholderA person or group affected by, or involved in, the solution.
record of tasksA chronological account of development work and decisions.
system modelA representation of components, relationships, and behavior in a system.
complexity evidenceProof that the product includes sufficient technical challenge.
evaluationA justified judgement of strengths, limitations, and improvements.

Crit A Planning and requirements

What the command expects

Command term: Apply

Define a clear client problem and measurable success criteria.

Key idea

Planning and requirements is treated as applied reasoning, not only a definition. Apply it within the internal-assessment cycle from planning to evaluation. Each criterion must be evidenced explicitly in the written solution and aligned to the official IA structure.

Applied in context

  • Keep requirements measurable and stakeholder-linked.
  • Document design and implementation evidence with clear rationale.
  • Evaluate outcomes directly against original criteria.

Quick worked example

A valid IA example links one stakeholder requirement to one measurable success criterion and one demonstrated product behavior.
